outcome_text: A sequence you would be willing to receive.
summary_text: Draft a focused outbound sequence from your lead sheet.
what_you_get: The thing the segment actually shares
Three emails that earn the next one
One ask per email, with a date
A refusal when the segment shares nothing
what_it_does: Finds the thing the segment actually shares, not the thing you hoped it shares
Three emails, each of which earns the next one
One ask per email, always with a date
Refuses to write the sequence when the segment has nothing in common

it_will_be_able_to.capability: write the drafts into a doc

starts_when.note: Run it on any segment you choose
